channel.title: Somalia - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Somalia, every source cited.

item.title: One in 10 Somali women journalists feel safe
item.description: A new report by the National Union of Somali Journalists reveals widespread harassment and pay issues.

item.title: Uganda begins Somalia troop withdrawal
item.description: Uganda's military has started pulling out troops deployed under bilateral agreements, with a full withdrawal by end of 2027.

item.title: Somali women journalists face 96 reported abuses
item.description: SOMWA documented arrests, physical attacks, and digital harassment against media workers, particularly women.

item.title: Hawadle militias quit front lines in Hiran region
item.description: About 2,000 fighters have seized government offices in Beledweyne, seeking an administration independent of Mogadishu.
